reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in our DM to say I'd keep the possible Door 23 change at the Marrow Agrisupply store between us. I told them I wouldn't repeat it anywhere or treat it as confirmed.

Before replying, I searched GBrain for "Marrow Agrisupply." It had a few notes about the account but nothing about a Door 23 move. That search was keyword-only, so it may have missed things. I didn't save the rumor anywhere and didn't post it in any channel or send it to anyone else.
